title: Novel Targets for the Development of Monoclonal Antibodies for Immunotherapy)
official: Nuovi Bersagli Per lo Sviluppo di Anticorpi Monoclonali Per Immunoterapia - (Novel Targets for the Development of Monoclonal Antibodies for Immunotherapy)
summary: The first objective of the project consists in the preclinical validation of new possible molecular targets associated with intratumoral T regulatory cells. The second objective consists in the selection of monoclonal antibodies with therapeutic potential, specific for the selected targets.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* blood donors
* age of 18 years or more
* able to sign informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* age below 18 years
* Positive for HIV, HCV, HBV
* not suitable for blood donation
* not able to understand or sign informed consent
